answer.title: Monthly KPI Report Automation
answer.trigger: Triggered on the first working day of each month at 09:00.
steps: Export the latest job report from the jobs system
Calculate the key performance indicators from the exported data
Update the monthly KPI spreadsheet with the new figures
Send the final KPI report via email to management
answer.ai_help: AI calculates key metrics and summarizes the job report data before updating the spreadsheet.
answer.human_approval: Review and approve the updated KPI spreadsheet and email before it is sent to management.
answer.risk_reason: Mistakes in internal KPI reporting are easily corrected and do not directly impact customers or finances.
